name: Pangram
description_en:
Pangram is an AI-content detection service for reviewing writing, with a dashboard, integrations and a developer API. Its text model estimates segments of human-written, AI-assisted or AI-generated prose. It is an analysis layer for a content or submission workflow, not a general CMS, authoring repository or proof of an author’s conduct.

Interpret the specific model’s fields and limits before using results. The Pangram4model card requires substantial prose, distinguishes composition scores from probabilities and acknowledges errors. Subscription word/image allowances, developer API credits and data-retention arrangements are separate evaluation questions.
description_zh:
Pangram是AI内容检测服务，提供写作审阅面板、集成及开发API。文本模型估计文章中人工、AI辅助或AI生成的片段，是内容/提交流程的分析层，并非通用CMS、创作资料库或作者行为的证明。

使用前需理解具体模型字段及限制。Pangram4模型卡要求较完整的自然语言文章，区分内容构成分数与概率，并承认存在错误。订阅字数/图像额度、开发API积分及数据保留安排需分别评估。

core_features.explanation_en: ThePangram4card describes three provenance labels plus character-weighted document fractions and segment offsets.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pangram4模型卡描述三类来源标签、按字符加权的文档比例及片段位置。

core_features.explanation_en: Purchase API credits and submit text through theSDK;realtime and bulk modes have different price/limit conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可购API积分并以SDK提交文本，实时及批量模式价格/限制不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid plans add word/image allowances,file/OCR and document/email integrations,while team billing and seats are separate.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费版增加字数/图像额度、文件/OCR及文档/邮件集成，团队计费及席位另列。

pricing.summary_zh: Individual试用7天后每月$20；Professional$65含更高额度及每月$200API积分；Team两席$40。Pangram4实时API每100词$0.05、批量优惠20%。提及Free版但额度/条件未核，币种代码/年付结账未知。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Use detection as a review signal for suitable prose
sections.title_zh: 对合适文章将检测作为审阅信号
sections.en:
For an editorial pilot, select a complete article for which the team has permission to process the text, keep its source/version and submit the relevant prose. Inspect the returned segments alongside drafts and the author’s explanation. A mixed label can identify material worth discussing; it does not establish misconduct, copying or a specific person’s writing process. This is a proposed workflow, not a document scan performed here.

The assigned catalogue category is content management, but the current official product is a detector that can feed aCMS/LMS/moderation queue. It does not supply the full publishing repository or editorial application. Image detection, similarity detection and text AI detection are different tasks; this research’s detailed model evidence concernsPangram4text analysis.
sections.zh:
编辑试点可选团队有权处理的完整文章，保留来源/版本，再提交相关正文。应结合草稿和作者说明查看返回片段；混合标签可提示讨论内容，但不能证明违规、抄袭或特定个人写作过程。上述为建议流程，本次未检测文档。

原分配目录为内容管理，但当前官方产品是可接入CMS/LMS/审核队列的检测器，不提供完整发布资料库或编辑应用。图像检测、相似性检测及文本AI检测属于不同任务，本次详细模型证据针对Pangram4文本分析。

sections.title_en: Read the model-specific output without turning scores into certainty
sections.title_zh: 按模型解释输出，不能把分数当确定结论
sections.en:
ThePangram4card describes segments labeledHuman,AI-AssistedorAI-Generated. Its ai_assistance_score combines model weights for AI-generated and partially weighted AI-assisted text; it is not the probability of the displayed label. Segment confidence describes local model confidence and explicitly is not a calibrated probability. Document fractions are character-weighted composition estimates that sum to one, not the probability that an entire document or person usedAI.

In this model’s documented summary rules, aHumanheadline requires at least90%human-classified characters,AIrequires at least80%AI-generated characters, and the remainder isMixed. Report the model/version and segment detail rather than applying those thresholds to a different model. This source is thePangram4card datedJuly29,2026; the site also exposes other model versions, whose behavior was not established here.
sections.zh:
Pangram4模型卡将片段标为Human、AI-Assisted或AI-Generated。ai_assistance_score组合AI生成权重及部分加权AI辅助，不是显示标签的概率；片段confidence描述局部模型信心，明确不是校准概率。文档比例是按字符加权、总和为1的构成估计，不是整篇或某个人使用AI的概率。

该模型摘要规则中，Human要求至少90%字符归为人工，AI要求至少80%归为AI生成，其余Mixed。应报告模型/版本和片段细节，不能将阈值套到其他模型。该来源为2026年7月29日Pangram4模型卡，站点也提供其他版本，本次未建立其行为。

sections.title_en: Keep input format and error rates in view
sections.title_zh: 关注输入格式及错误范围
sections.en:
Pangram4is intended for at least50words of natural-language prose in complete sentences. The card places source code, mathematical material, short factual replies, templates, reference lists and technical manuals outside its main scope or at greater error risk. It recommends removing unrelated headers/footers and preferring raw text orDOCXtoPDFwhen available because parsing artifacts can affect input. Its segment boundaries are constrained to roughly two sentences, so do not read a highlight as exact forensic attribution of each token.

The card acknowledges nonzero errors and the harm of false accusations. Its reported evaluation rates depend on datasets, languages and operating settings; they were not independently reproduced and are not a guarantee for a student, employee or article. Use review, context and an opportunity to respond instead of an automatic adverse decision from a detection score alone.
sections.zh:
Pangram4面向至少50词、以完整句子组成的自然语言文章。模型卡将源码、数学材料、简短事实回答、模板、参考列表及技术手册列为非主要范围或错误风险更高，建议移除无关页眉/页脚，条件允许时优先纯文本或DOCX，因为PDF解析可能引入异常。片段边界约束为大约两个句子，不能将高亮当作每个token的精确取证归属。

模型卡承认非零错误率及误指控危害，其评估率取决于数据集、语言和设置，本次未独立复现，也不保证某学生、员工或文章的结果。应结合审阅、上下文及说明机会，不能仅凭检测分数自动作不利决定。

sections.title_en: Separate subscription allowances from developer API spend
sections.title_zh: 区分订阅额度及开发API费用
sections.en:
The pricing page displaysIndividual$20/month after a7-day trial, with300,000words/month and100image scans. Professional displays$65/month, five times the word/image allowance and$200monthly API credits. Team displays$40/month for two seats at$20/seat, with unified billing and administration. AFreeplan is referenced, but its actual quota and continuing conditions were not exposed in the text read; the trial is not evidence of unlimited free use. Annual savings are shown without a fully verified annual checkout total or currency code.

The developer page quotesPangram4realtime API at$0.05per100words with a5QPSlimit; bulk receives20%discount and lists a1,000billable-unit limit, not a verified1,000-document entitlement. Prepaid API credits and optional auto-refill are separate from subscription word allowances. Confirm rounding/minimum billable units, rate limits, credit expiry, tax and refill rules before processing a large queue. No paid call or billing operation was executed.
sections.zh:
定价页显示Individual试用7天后每月$20，含每月300,000词及100图像扫描；Professional每月$65，字数/图像额度为五倍，另含每月$200API积分。Team每月$40含两席、每席$20，提供统一计费及管理。页面提到Free版，但实读文本未展示具体额度和持续条件；试用不证明无限免费。页面列年度节省额，但本次未完整核实年付结账总额或币种代码。

开发页将Pangram4实时API标为每100词$0.05、限5QPS；批量优惠20%，列上限1,000billable units，不能当作已核实1,000文档权益。预付API积分及可选自动充值与订阅字数额度分开。大批处理前需确认取整/最低计费单位、限流、积分到期、税及充值规则，本次未执行付费调用或计费。

sections.title_en: Specify retention and model version in the integration
sections.title_zh: 在集成中明确保留策略及模型版本
sections.en:
The API page describes generating a key, usingPANGRAM_API_KEYwith thePythonSDKand calling predict with the intended model. Keep the key in server-side configuration and handle failed/rate-limited jobs without assuming a result exists. The public example disables a public dashboard link, but that flag alone is not a verified zero-retention agreement. Enterprise zero-retention options require separate confirmation.

The privacyFAQ says dashboard/extension submissions are stored for history while an account is active and can be deleted through history;LMSintegrations also store matching metadata. It says submitted content is not used in its detection training dataset and is not sold/shared with third parties. These are vendor policy statements, not a tested deletion or contractual audit. Confirm API-specific retention, region, permissions and sensitive-text handling for the selected service. A model using an open-weight backbone does not make the hosted detector or model weights freely licensed.
sections.zh:
API页描述生成密钥、Python SDK使用PANGRAM_API_KEY并以指定模型调用predict。密钥应留在服务端配置，失败/限流任务不能假定已有结果。公开示例关闭公开面板链接，但该标志本身不是已核实零保留协议；企业零保留选项需另确认。

隐私FAQ称面板/扩展提交在账户活跃期间存作历史，可通过历史删除；LMS集成另存匹配元数据，并称提交内容不进入其检测训练数据集、不向第三方出售/分享。这些是厂商政策陈述，不是已测试删除或合同审计。需确认所选API的保留、区域、权限及敏感文本处理。模型使用开放权重骨干，也不意味着托管检测器或模型权重有免费许可。
